name: free5GC
what_it_is: free5GC is an open-source 5G core network implementation based on 3GPP Release 15+, written in Go. It provides all standard 5G core network functions (NFs) and is designed for research, development, and testing of 5G infrastructure.
protocols: NGAP (NG Application Protocol) — RAN-to-AMF N2 interface
PFCP (Packet Forwarding Control Protocol) — SMF-to-UPF N4 interface
GTP-U (GPRS Tunneling Protocol User Plane) — user-plane tunneling on N3/N9
SBI (Service Based Interface) — HTTP/2-based inter-NF REST APIs
measurement: No built-in metrics exporter or Prometheus endpoint documented in core repo
Test suite covers multi-UPF topologies and ULCL (Uplink Classifier) scenarios
Logs per NF written to stdout/file; log level configurable per NF
configuration: Per-NF YAML config files under config/ directory (e.g., amfcfg.yaml, smfcfg.yaml)
Network slice configuration via NSSF and SMF config files
Multi-UPF and ULCL path-selection configurable in SMF UE routing config
Subscriber data (IMSI, keys, slice info) managed via Webconsole or direct MongoDB inserts
fault_injection: No built-in fault injection framework; test scripts can simulate UE attach/detach flows
Individual NFs can be stopped/restarted in Docker Compose to simulate NF failure
modes: All-in-one deployment via Docker Compose (free5gc-compose companion repo, ~15 services)
ULCL (Uplink Classifier) mode for traffic steering
constraints: Requires Linux kernel with GTP5G kernel module loaded on UPF host; does not run on macOS or Windows natively
UPF (go-upf) requires kernel 5.4+ with gtp5g module; incompatible with standard container runtimes without --privileged and host networking
No built-in RAN — requires a separate gNodeB simulator (e.g., UERANSIM) to exercise the full stack
MongoDB is a hard runtime dependency; no alternative data store supported
SBI interfaces use plain HTTP/2 by default; TLS mutual auth requires manual certificate provisioning
N3IWF requires a separate network interface and IPsec support; not easily sandboxed
notable_absences: No built-in packet capture or traffic analysis tooling
No gNodeB/RAN simulator included — must supply UERANSIM or equivalent separately
No support for 5G SA roaming (inter-PLMN) in the base setup
